author: Cleep
changelog:
## [1.0.0] - 2026-09-01

### Added
- Add read-only NFC reader module with serial and nfcpy backends
- Emit nfcreader.tag.detected events when NFC tag UIDs are read
- Add reader status events and configuration UI
- Document ISO15693/NFC-V reader requirement for Tonie-style tags
label: NFC reader
longdescription: Reads NFC tag UIDs and emits Cleep events when a tag is detected. For Tonie characters, use reader hardware that supports ISO15693/NFC-V tags.
